name: io.github.nutlope/inspo
description: Design inspiration for coding agents: real production sites with palettes, fonts, fold autopsies, and canonical reference JSX.

environmentVariables.name: TOGETHER_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Enables query-embedding semantic search; everything else works without it.

environmentVariables.name: INSPO_CATALOGUE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Point at a self-hosted catalogue instead of the public CDN.

environmentVariables.name: INSPO_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Optional. 'lite' or 'full' tool surface (auto-detected per client by default).

environmentVariables.name: INSPO_IMAGES
environmentVariables.description: Optional. 'thumbs' or 'none' - whether tool results inline thumbnail image blocks.
